description: If \(c,u\) and \(d,v\) give bounded-use reductions of \(A\) and \(D\) to \(B\), and a total computable binary operation maps Boolean pairs to Boolean values and sends their membership bits to the membership bit of \(E\), pairing the two actual programs and then applying that ordinary operation gives a bounded-use reduction of \(E\) to \(B\) with bound \(\max(u(x),v(x))\).
